system.description:
Don't ever let them see your next move. If you select this component, replace the Cannon with it.

Attack (Fist): Make a Power Roll against the target. On a success the target takes d8 + 4 damage.

Attach (Fist): On a successful attack you can spend a Hope to shoot a rope that sticks temporarily to the enemy.

Tug-of-war (Fist): Make a Power Roll against an attached target. On a success you can pull your ship closer to the target or pull the target behind you.
system.gmNotes: The printed stat line says d8 + 6 damage; the Attack feature says d8 + 4. Both are kept as printed.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
